summary: CI's objectives (merge-latency/p50 and /p95, ci-critical-path/p95, flakes) read the same real values on every member, from a Workspace CI reading the repository observation replicates

replay.detail: No replay or rebuild. The rows are computed on read from the resource observation projection every member already keeps.

schema.detail: Adds an optional workspace_ci object to vcs.repository facts and regenerates the schema registry documentation; the registry digest changes. No tables, columns or migration. It holds the repository, the read time (observed_at_unix_ms) and the runs a row reads: each run's id, event, conclusion, attempt when not 1, from_unix_ms, until_unix_ms and flaky count once listed. Only a github.repository observer that reads main_performance_failures writes it. Older readers quarantine a fact with an unknown resource field: upgrade every member before the field is written.

rules.detail: Claim kinds, rules, permissions and digests are unchanged. The fact rides the existing resource.observed claim of the repository, replicated and locally trimmed like every other observation.

compatibility.detail: st slo, GET /v1/slo and GET /v1/client/slo list the four CI rows with the same ids, targets, windows and SloRow fields on every member, computed from the newest replicated reading; each explain names the reading member (host/NAME) and its age. A reading older than 15 minutes (three five-minute polls) is no-data with current 'reading too old', never met. The process-local copy of the runs and the one-repository-per-daemon rule are gone: a failed read records the previous reading unchanged, and flaky test counts travel in the fact, so a run's artifacts are listed once whichever member polls. A missed row opens its fault only on the member whose observer recorded the reading; any member ends a fault it has open once the row is met. Size: a green run is about 125 bytes; a typical day keeps 100 to 200 runs, 13 to 25 KB an observation, at most 2,000 runs (under 320 KB) under the listings' bounds; about 288 observations a day at the five-minute cadence. No new GitHub reads or polling.

downtime.detail: None. The reads keep the observer's cadence and the rows are computed on read.

manual.detail: Deploy this build to every member first. Then activate, as before, by subscribing the owner agent to main_performance_failures on the shared observer (subscription on observer/github/compoundingtech/fractal, on "main_performance_failures", delivery "message", to the owner agent, applied with fractal apply FILE --as that agent); the observer reads and records Workspace CI only with that field.

recovery.detail: Before downgrading, stop the main_performance_failures subscription so no older build is asked to observe the field. Recorded workspace_ci facts stay in replicated observations; an older build quarantines them during replay, so keep supporting readers until the observations carrying the field are trimmed. Binary rollback returns the four rows to the previous behavior.
